description: Implementation of a fake content repository for testing or development purposes, providing methods to fetch home feed data, search content items, and retrieve items by ID, based on a predefined collection of content items.

classes.name: FakeContentRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of ContentRepository that returns predefined content data asynchronously.

methods.name: _library
methods.description: Private method returning a static list of ContentItem instances representing mock content data.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches a simulated home feed with shuffled content rails after a brief delay.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches the mock content data for items matching the query in title or description.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ContentItem by its ID from the mock data, returning null if not found.
